Task description: Use the right arm to pick up the stamp with a beige handle and yellow base, then stamp the purple block. In this round, the purple block is at the lower left of the stamp in the image.

Success criteria: The stamp’s position in the tabletop plane is aligned near the center of the purple block, with only a small left-right and front-back offset; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- The right gripper can grasp the narrower section just below the rounded end of the beige handle, leaving clearance between the pads and the yellow base. This reduces the risk of slipping off the rounded top or hitting the base.
- Set the gripper opening slightly wider than the selected handle section. Before closing, confirm both fingers are on opposite sides of the handle rather than contacting one side and pushing the stamp over.
- Lift the stamp base off the table during lateral movement while keeping the stamping face down. Near the target, correct placement from the overhead view rather than mistaking the higher handle's image position for the bottom stamping face.
- Near the target, lower the item slowly and complete lateral adjustments before contact. Release only after the base is securely supported to reduce dragging, tipping, or placement offset.
